mapper.sql: FROM wf_task_action a JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = a.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = a.tenant_id JOIN wf_definition d ON d.id = i.definition_id AND d.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN wf_task t ON t.id = a.task_id AND t.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.operator_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.project_id IS NULL OR i.project_id IN #{id})AND i.project_id IS NULL

SELECT a.id, a.instance_id, a.task_id, a.action_code, a.comment, a.created_at, t.node_id, t.task_key, t.task_type, i.business_key, i.business_type, i.business_title, i.business_round, i.project_ref, i.project_name, i.action_path, i.status AS instance_status, d.name AS definition_name
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
AND (a.created_at < #{cursorCreatedAt} OR (a.created_at = #{cursorCreatedAt} AND a.id < #{cursorId})) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{size}
